verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed that incident.io serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200) at docs.incident.io/llms.txt. It points agents to a markdown rendering of the 456-page help center, which is directly consumable agent-oriented documentation. A downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec adds machine-readable API docs, though the probe found it at none of the standard paths. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-docs offering, the API reference in the llms.txt index (it lists only the help center), and independent corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.incident.io/llms.txt # incident.io
